title: ContextWeir settings.json

relayPort.description: Receiving port. Your frontend connects here, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5002/v1. It never moves on its own. Applies: after Restart.

targetHost.description: Model server (this computer). Used unless "Allow a model server on another computer" is ticked below. Applies: after Restart.

targetPort.description: Model server port. KoboldCpp's default is 5001. Applies: after Restart.

allowRemoteModel.description: Allow a model server on another computer. Off: only this computer. On: your chats go over the network to the address below (another PC, Tailscale or a cloud service). A warning explains the risk before anything is sent. Applies: after Restart.

remoteUrl.description: Model server on another computer. The address up to (not including) /v1, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:5001 or https://openrouter.ai/api. Your frontend sends its API key with each request; ContextWeir passes it on and never saves it. Applies: after Restart.

logsDir.description: Log folder. Relative to the ContextWeir folder, or a full path. The folder above it must exist. Applies: after Restart.

keepSessions.description: Sessions to keep. Older session folders are deleted when a session starts. Applies: at once.

maxRecordsPerSession.description: Most turns per session. After this many, turns still pass through but are not saved. Applies: at once.

sillyTavernDir.description: SillyTavern folder (optional). Only its package.json is read, for the version number noted in each session. Leave empty to skip. Applies: after Restart.

maxRequestMB.description: Largest request (MB). Larger requests are refused. Applies: at once.

maxReplyMB.description: Largest reply kept (MB). Longer replies still pass through; the log keeps this much. Applies: at once.

upstreamTimeoutSec.description: Model timeout (seconds). Give up on a model that sends nothing for this long. Applies: at once.

ruleTimeoutMs.description: Rule time limit (ms). A rule that takes longer is switched off for the session. Applies: at once.

showStartScreen.description: Show the start screen. Untick to start recording as soon as ContextWeir opens. The screen still comes back if the receiving port is taken. Applies: at once.

showThanks.description: Show the thank-you note. The note shown when the panel opens. Untick "Don't show this again" in it, or here. Applies: at once.

remoteWarningAcceptedFor.description: Outside-address warning accepted for. Set only by the warning's "Don't show this again" (for that one address). Empty it to see the warning again. Applies: at once.
